title: rust Type::method qualifier preservation
summary: tldr impact <Type>::<method>, whatbreaks <Type>::<method>, and context <file>:<Type>::<method> now preserve the Type:: qualifier and resolve only to methods inside the matching impl block instead of every same-named function across the corpus.
root_cause: find_function_in_ast (impact.rs) used extract_methods which emits bare method names for Rust impl blocks, so every same-named method matched a user-typed qualified target via the symmetric names_match.

names_match accepted target=qualified+candidate=bare via tail equality, originally introduced for Python Class.method but over-broad for Rust Type::method since the call graph also emits qualified Rust forms.
fix: Added extract_rust_impl_methods_qualified in crates/tldr-core/src/ast/extractor.rs that walks impl_item and trait_item nodes and emits Type::method (and Trait::method) qualified candidates.

Tightened names_match in crates/tldr-core/src/analysis/impact.rs: when the target uses the :: separator we require exact-match OR a candidate whose qualifier ends with the user-typed qualifier; we no longer fall through to bare/tail-equal relaxations for :: targets. Dot-qualified targets retain the legacy permissive behavior so Python Class.method still works.
Wired the new extractor into find_function_in_ast: when target contains :: and language is Rust we use the qualified extractor and accept only candidates whose impl-type matches the typed qualifier.
scope_guard: Only the canonical `impl Type::method` and `trait Trait::method` forms are handled. UFCS `<MyType as Trait>::method` is deferred to a follow-up.

pre_fix_evidence.tldr impact Glob::parse /tmp/repos/ripgr: 3 unrelated targets including crates/core/flags/parse.rs:parse and crates/core/flags/config.rs:parse

post_fix_evidence.tldr impact Parser::parse /tmp/repos/rip: 2 targets, both keys ending in Parser::parse (qualifier preserved): crates/core/flags/parse.rs:Parser::parse, crates/globset/src/glob.rs:Parser::parse
post_fix_evidence.tldr impact parse /tmp/repos/ripgrep: 3 targets (unchanged baseline - bare-name queries still work)
